{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.08

|gr1= Sounds

|descr= Returns an array containing the names and values of environmental 3D sound controllers, variables that can be used in simple expressions when configuring sounds.
{{Feature|important|
* Controller names are case sensitive
* Wind param difference:
** {{hl|wind}} is for '''3D''' controller
** {{hl|wind'''y'''}} is for '''2D''' controller ([[getAllEnvSoundControllers]])
}}

|s1= [[getAllEnv3DSoundControllers]] object

|p1= object: [[Object]] - environmental sound source like a tree or a house, see [[allEnv3DSoundSources]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [<nowiki/>["controllerA", valueA], ["controllerB", valueB], ...], controllers being, in order:
{{Columns|3|
* {{hl|"rain"}}
* {{hl|"night"}}
* {{hl|"wind"}}
* {{hl|"daytime"}}
* {{hl|"distance"}}
* {{hl|"shooting"}}
* {{hl|"meadows"}}
* {{hl|"trees"}}
* {{hl|"houses"}}
* {{hl|"forest"}}
* {{hl|"sea"}}
* {{hl|"altitudeSea"}}
* {{hl|"altitudeGround"}}
* {{hl|"rainDrops"}}
* {{hl|"yearTime"}}
* {{hl|"ambientTemp"}}
* {{hl|"snow"}}
}}

|x1= <sqf>
getAllEnv3DSoundControllers _thatTreeOverThere;
/*
	returns e.g
	[
		["rain",0],
		["night",0],
		["wind",0.161588],
		...
	]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getAllEnvSoundControllers]] [[getEnv3DSoundController]] [[allEnv3DSoundSources]] [[selectBestPlaces]] [[getSoundController]] [[getSoundControllerResult]] [[getEnvSoundController]] [[getAllSoundControllers]] [[getCustomSoundController]] [[setCustomSoundController]] [[getCustomSoundControllerCount]] [[Arma 3: Sound]]
}}
